'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Thomas Whalen DS My Lord Is That Legal''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whalen]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Thomas Whalen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
